# PlaySpotStore (https://playspotstore.online/)

> PlayStation (PS5, PS4, PS3, PS2), Xbox, Nintendo Switch games, consoles, accessories and console maintenance guides in Chișinău, Republic of Moldova. Bilingual catalog in Romanian (RO) and Russian (RU).

## Core URLs
- Homepage (RO): https://playspotstore.online/
- Homepage (RU): https://playspotstore.online/ru.html
- Sitemap: https://playspotstore.online/sitemap.xml
- Terms & Conditions: https://playspotstore.online/termeni.html
- Privacy Policy: https://playspotstore.online/confidentialitate.html

## Catalog & Guides
- Bilingual gaming guides (94 guides: 47 RO ↔ 47 RU) covering PS5/PS4/Xbox/Switch troubleshooting, NAT Type 2, DualSense battery, Console Sharing, PS Plus tiers, monitors vs OLED TVs, and game recommendations.
- Personal pickup in Chișinău and courier delivery across the Republic of Moldova.
